scope: CPU JavaScript codec parity only: the Spark body shipped inside this repo bundle (cc.sparkRuntime) versus the frozen upstream reference package dist/spark-reference.js, both imported in one browser document on one loopback origin. No pixels, no WebGL, no worker, no XR session.
strictRule: Object.is equality for all 65536 fromHalf patterns and the 14 toHalf boundary edges; byte-exact Uint32 words for 256 setPackedSplat and encodeExtSplat vectors and Object.is for every unpackSplat field; sorted export-name sets differ by exactly the registered 27 SparkXr/hands exclusions with nothing extra in the target; the five namespace key sets equal; negative controls must report mismatches while the real comparison reports none; zero page/console errors; source/asset digest unchanged.
claimLimit: What ships in THIS repo versus the upstream package, on THIS machine, for these pure CPU functions. It is not a GPU or rendering claim (that is spark-pixel-parity), not a WASM decode claim (that is spark-data-parity), and not a release READY claim. The reference is served read-only from the port repo; no file was copied into this repo.

referenceOrigin.note: read-only port repository over loopback, single origin shared with /build and /tools of this repo
